allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on July 04, 2025 for Allotment of Equity Shares pursuant to Rights Issue.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 for allotment of equity shares on rights basis

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange about Letter of Offer dated June 06, 2025, for Rights Issue of equity shares

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on Jun 06, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 4 : 43, i.e 4 Equity Shares for every 43 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 1800 per share.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Please find enclosed the Draft Letter of Offer dated June 03, 2025 for the Rights Issue of Ethos Limited.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held today i.e. June 3, 2025, has, inter-alia, considered and approved Raising of funds through the issuance of equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each by way of rights issue for an amount not exceeding Rs 410 Crore

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Ethos Limited has informed the Exchange regarding  Board meeting held on Jun 03, 2025  inter-alia, to considered and approved Raising of funds through the issuance of equity shares of face value Rs 10 each by way of rights issue for an amount not exceeding Rs 410 Crore.
